# ShipCheck

ShipCheck is a free AI browser testing tool by Safdar Ali.

URL: https://shipcheck.safdarali.in

## What it does

- Test websites in plain English — no code, no signup
- Run real browser checks with Playwright (click, fill, verify)
- Get screenshots, step logs, and pass/fail bug reports
- Compare UI screenshots pixel by pixel (visual regression)
- Export JSON reports

## Keywords

ai browser testing free, visual regression testing, plain english testing, compare screenshots online

## Author

Safdar Ali — https://safdarali.in
